integrity: A complete analytic argument uses established Stieltjes/complete-Bernstein reciprocity and a two-stage maximum principle. Exact-rational tests are finite supplementary checks. Historical priority is not independently established.
scientific_limitations: Positive non-point compactly supported scale mixtures only; real even finite cosine masks; no extension to signed mixing, noncompact support or higher-dimensional domains.
title: Finite-knot positivity and all-mode reopening for signed Poisson-mixture covariances
